summary: Build high-quality Agent Skills for any agent - opinionated best practices distilled from the Agent Skills spec, official Anthropic guidance, and production experience. Covers SKILL.md structure, frontmatter, description writing, single-file vs references/ layout, progressive disclosure, testing, patterns, troubleshooting, and distribution across all surfaces (Claude.ai, Claude Code, API, Agent SDK). Use when creating a skill, reviewing skill quality, debugging why a skill won't trigger, structuring skill directories, or writing skill descriptions.
